name: @pragma-sh/junie-plugin
description: JetBrains Junie CLI plugin that reports agent status to Pragma via native hooks.

scripts.build: bun build src/pragma-plugin.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target node --packages bundle && mv dist/pragma-plugin.js dist/pragma-plugin.mjs && bun build scripts/install-local.ts --outfile dist/install.mjs --format esm --target node --packages bundle
